original_target.title: Coexistence for every positive cyclic invasion rate

scope_comparison: The live Durrett book's Open Problem 3.5.2 still asks coexistence at every positive cyclic invasion rate. Its periodic mean-field orbits and finite lattice simulations do not construct an infinite-lattice translation-invariant stationary law in which all three types coexist almost surely. Ecological ODE invasion-graph results differ from this nearest-neighbor Markov system.
